A tank is provided with two inlet pipes, A and B, and one outlet pipe, C. Pipe A alone can fill the tank completely in 12 hours, while pipe B alone can do so in 18 hours. Pipe C, on the other hand, can empty the full tank in 36 hours. Initially, all three pipes are opened simultaneously and allowed to operate together. After 4 hours of operation, the outlet pipe C is closed, while the inlet pipes A and B continue to function. Determine how much additional time (in hours) will be required to fill the tank completely. Ans A). 4 B). 5 C). 6 D). 3 Correct Answer: A

What is the average sale of cars per day on Saturdays, if the first Saturday is on the 3rd of March and average sale of cars per day for the whole month is 199? Which of the following is NOT correct regarding the properties of a circle? Ans A). The ratio of perimeter and diameter of a circle is constant. B). The largest chord divides the circle in two equal halves. C). The length of a chord decreases when the chord is drawn near to centre. D). The largest chord of the circle with radius 7 units has length 14 units. Correct Answer: C
questions.key_answer: The length of a chord decreases when the chord is drawn near to centre.
